learning_objective: 🎯 Explore the beautiful diversity, the protective mountains, and the ancient names of our incredible home country, India!

main_concepts.concept_title: 🇮🇳 What is in a Name?: India and Bharat
main_concepts.simple_explanation: Our country is famous by two main names: India, which comes from the mighty river Indus, and Bharat, which comes from ancient texts and powerful kings of the past.
India is like a giant fortress. The tall snowy Himalayas protect us in the north, while huge oceans surround us on three sides in the south, making it a unique subcontinent.

main_concepts.concept_title: 🤝 Unity in Diversity: Many Colors, One Nation
main_concepts.simple_explanation: In India, people speak different languages, wear different clothes, and celebrate different festivals. But even with all these amazing differences, we all live happily together as one big family!

fun_activity.title: 🪔 The Culture Explorer
fun_activity.instructions: Ask your parents or grandparents to tell you about a special traditional dish or a unique festival from your home state. Draw a picture of it in your notebook!

quick_recap: ⭐ India is also beautifully known as Bharat.
⭐ The geography of India is diverse, with the giant Himalayas in the north and oceans in the south.
⭐ India is famous for 'Unity in Diversity', meaning we are one strong nation with many different vibrant cultures.
